<issue>
Property setter inference broken after decorator filtering change

#### Description

Property setters are not being inferred correctly. When accessing a property that has a setter defined, the inference fails and returns an `Uninferable` instead of the expected property value.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
import astroid

code = """
class PropertyWithSetter:
    @property
    def host(self):
        return self._host

    @host.setter
    def host(self, value: str):
        self._host = value

PropertyWithSetter().host
"""

module = astroid.parse(code)
prop_access = list(module.nodes_of_class(astroid.Attribute))[-1]
inferred = next(prop_access.infer())
print(type(inferred))  # Should be a property value, not Uninferable
```

This also affects more complex property inference scenarios:

```python
code = '''
class A:
    @property
    def test(self):
        return 42

    @test.setter
    def test(self, value):
        return "banco"

A().test
'''

module = astroid.parse(code)
prop_access = list(module.nodes_of_class(astroid.Attribute))[-1]
inferred = next(prop_access.infer())
print(inferred.value)  # Should print 42
```

The property getter should return `42` but inference is failing completely.
</issue>
